dataset: UEA InsectWingbeat equal-length v2 (ten-class insect wingbeat classification)
task_note: Multivariate power spectrum/features of insect wingbeat signals; classes split mosquito species by sex and include fly types. Each official sample is described as frequency-band channels derived from a spectrogram. The current Zenodo equal-length v2 has 20 points/channel. UEA page gives current 25,000/25,000 split; older 2018 archive statistics differ.

pilot.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (6 GiB)
pilot.validation_split: class-stratified 20% from official train (500/class); test untouched for model selection
pilot.preprocessing: per-feature mean/std fitted on 20,000 train rows only

provenance_limit: No specimen/recording-group IDs were present in the parsed .ts files; whether the random-looking official split separates individual insects/recordings cannot be verified.
disposition: Keep provisionally as a difficult non-saturated 10-class classification benchmark: full-batch MLPs score about 45-50% versus 10% majority and execute comfortably on the target GPU. One seed and unavailable specimen IDs limit generalization claims.
